source_caption_text:
In August, Nino Paid dropped his second album, Somewhere Over the Rainbow. Less than four weeks later, Border Patrol arrested him coming back from Canada on an Atlanta murder warrant. Police say Ring camera footage identified the 2025 XXL Freshman as an accomplice in the April shooting death of 29-year-old Keion Borders near the Old Fourth Ward. Chicago rapper Warhol.SS turned himself in two weeks later. Both men face felony murder and armed robbery charges and are being held without bond. Under Georgia's felony murder law, prosecutors don't have to prove who pulled the trigger, and a conviction carries a mandatory life sentence. In this video I break down how the case came together, what the charges mean, and how the defense could fight it. Both men have been charged, not convicted, and are presumed innocent.
